(expediente: AAU/CA/040/23)'. The refusal is of the AAU for the project itself, so aau / desfavorable. developer and expediente as printed. project_name is the park; the 'e infraestructura de evacuacion' suffix is dropped. technology eolica from 'Parque Eolico'. No capacity figure appears anywhere in the resolution (the full binding report is only linked), so mw_nominal is null; mw_peak, hectares and turbines are omitted for the same reason. Municipalities: the title and both the operative part and the anexo give the same three, 'en los terminos municipales de El Puerto de Santa Maria, Jerez de la Frontera y Sanlucar de Barrameda (Cadiz)', without separating park from line, so all three are labelled.
